identification: Group of four small silver spoons: a continental (thread/shell style) dessert spoon, an Old English/plain-tip tablespoon-size spoon, a fiddle-pattern salt/egg spoon and a small souvenir-style spoon with shield finial. Mixed British-style and continental marks.
viewing_check: Weigh the four spoons and read the marks (look for lion passant, 800/830/84 stamps); a Georgian or Scottish provincial spoon would lift the lot.
